b: Featuring Concepción Huerta and Luka Aron among others, this large improvising ensemble contains multitudes

It is sticky and it penetrates the skin. That tingling feeling is tortuously triggering. Attentive listening is what is calling for Spydergum. This is the way the expansive electroacoustic ensemble mark the year with their most anticipated eponymous debut release. Their first record, a fully improvised body of work, is a testimony to the fact that to co-create means to begin to listen deep.

Spydergum is an ecosystem of simultaneously communicating sonic bodies, encompassing an ever-morphing sticky web of diverse voices and instruments.
